lines: Koi fariyaad tere dil mein dabi ho jaise
couplets.en: As though your heart held an unspoken plea.

lines: Tune aankhon se koi baat kahi ho jaise
couplets.en: As though your eyes had said something.

lines: Jaagte jaagte ek umr kati ho jaise
couplets.en: As though a lifetime had passed without sleep.

lines: Jaan baaqi hai magar saans ruki ho jaise
couplets.en: As though life lingered after the breath had stopped.

lines: Har mulaaqaat pe mehsoos yahi hota hai
couplets.en: I feel the same each time we meet.

lines: Mujhse kuchh teri nazar poochh rahi ho jaise
couplets.en: As though your gaze were asking me something.

lines: Raah chalte hue aksar ye gumaan hota hai
couplets.en: Walking along, I often have this feeling.

lines: Woh nazar chhup ke mujhe dekh rahi ho jaise
couplets.en: As though those eyes were watching me unseen.

lines: Ek lamhe mein simat aaya hai sadiyon ka safar
couplets.en: A journey of centuries has folded into a moment.

lines: Zindagi tez, bahut tez chali ho jaise
couplets.en: As though life had swept by all too quickly.

lines: Is tarah pehron tujhe sochta rehta hoon main
couplets.en: I go on thinking of you like this for hours.

lines: Meri har saans tere naam likhi ho jaise
couplets.en: As though each breath of mine were written in your name.
